name: control-panel/open-category
description: Open Control Panel and click the System and Security category.
source_task: Open Control Panel and click "System and Security". This is an unattended test. Do not wait for a person. Decide yourself. Never buy, send, submit, save or delete anything. Leave the application window open when you are done.

steps.note: Control Panel is reached through File Explorer's address bar.
Moves the caret into the address bar.

else.goal: Control Panel is showing icons instead of categories. Open the 'View by' dropdown and choose 'Category' so the category links appear. Do not open or change any setting.

steps.note: The window title changes to the category name only if the click opened it. The window is left open.
